title: Retiring your service
locator: Consider user needs; Telling your users; Make a plan to redirect traffic
short_quote: how the user need your service met will be met
claim: Retirement distinguishes needs that disappear, needs served by a replacement, and needs no longer served by government. Users, direct-entry routes, APIs and assisted channels require transition consideration.
limits: Whole-service retirement guidance. Applying its preservation questions to an individual feature is this campaign’s inference. Government-specific notification and domain-retention rules are not transplanted.
publication_safety: Metadata and short quotation only; retained source text stays private.
